name: Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd.
business_summary: Diversified Indian group flagship: No.1 tractor maker (~35-40% share) and a leading SUV/utility-vehicle maker (Scorpio, Thar, XUV, Bolero and born-electric BE 6/XEV 9 series), plus LCVs, three-wheelers, with large stakes in Mahindra Finance (~52%) and Tech Mahindra (~26%) (stakes: model knowledge), hospitality, logistics and agri. Standalone Q2 FY27: revenue Rs 44,282 cr (+26%), EBITDA margin 15.2%. Promoter holding is only 18.4%; FIIs 33% (falling) and DIIs 34% (rising).

exposures.mechanism: Steel ~14% of standalone sales (SUVs, tractors; model estimate). +7% -> +1.0% of sales; standalone EBITDA margin 15.2% (Q2) -> -6.5% pre pass-through; ~55% recovered -> -2.9%; core auto+farm ~65% of market cap (rest is TechM/M&MFIN/other stakes) x persistence 0.4 -> -0.75. Q2 standalone EBITDA grew only 4% on 26% revenue growth, so margin already compressed ~320bp.

evidence.note: Standalone EBITDA +4% to Rs 6,718 cr on revenue +26% to Rs 44,282 cr (margin 15.2% vs 18.4%)

exposures.mechanism: Aluminium ~3% of sales; +10% -> 0.3% of sales -> EBITDA -2% pre; 55% recovered; x0.65 x0.4 = -0.23. Aluminium -19.6% since June is a tailwind.

Copper ~1.5% of sales (harness, EV motors/cables, tractors); +10% -> 0.15% of sales -> -1% EBITDA pre; x0.45 x0.65 x0.4 = -0.12 rounded -0.2. Pack empirical copper +0.52 (t 0.7): opposite sign, insignificant (global-growth proxy).

BEV share is small (XEV 9e/BE 6/XEV 9S; under ~5% of SUV volumes - model estimate); battery ~35% of BEV price. +15% cell cost -> ~0.4% of auto revenue pre pass-through -> ~-2.5% EBITDA x0.5 pass x0.65 x0.4 = -0.3.

evidence.note: BEV volume share not disclosed in fetched sources

exposures.mechanism: Direct channel: plastics/paints/lubricants/freight ~7% of sales (+0.2% of sales cost per +10% Brent) and diesel-linked rural tractor/pickup economics (diesel is the farm cost input). EBITDA -1.5% pre, -0.9% after pass-through; x0.65 x0.4 = -0.25 plus demand/sentiment -0.5. Pack Brent not among top 12 (insignificant).

evidence.note: Brent ~$94 and crude easing lifted auto stocks on 2026-11-05

exposures.mechanism: Roughly balanced: exports (SUVs, tractors incl. US; overseas tractor sales +40% in Oct) ~8% of sales vs imported components/electronics ~8% of cost. Net ~0; pack empirical +1.29 per +3% (t 0.9) insignificant. Kept near zero.

evidence.note: Tractor exports +40% y/y in Oct 2026 (2,220 units)

exposures.mechanism: Auto segment ~70% of standalone EBITDA. +10% industry volumes -> M&M auto volume +10% (gain share on top); contribution margin ~25% vs EBITDA margin 15.2% -> gearing 1.6x -> auto EBITDA +16% = total +11%; x0.65 x persistence 0.3 = +2.2, rounded +2.5. Q2 vehicle volumes +26% to 3.31 lakh, UV 1.83 lakh.

evidence.note: Total vehicle sales +26% to 3,30,896 units; UV 1.83 lakh

exposures.mechanism: Farm Equipment ~25% of standalone EBITDA plus rural UV/pickups. Tractor domestic sales Apr-Oct FY27 +2% only (Oct -13% on Diwali shift; Q2 -6%). +5pp rural growth -> tractor volume +5%, farm EBITDA +9% (gearing 1.8x) -> +2.3% total; x0.65 x0.5 = +0.75.

evidence.note: Domestic tractors 3.25 lakh Apr-Oct (+2%); Oct -13% due to festive calendar

exposures.mechanism: Two channels: (1) SUV/tractor finance demand: +25bp -> volume -0.4% x gearing 1.6 -> EBITDA -0.7% x0.65 x0.5 = -0.2; (2) consolidated lender M&M Finance NIM/credit cost and valuation multiple compression on a 20x P/E stock ~-0.6. RBI hiked to 5.50% on 2026-10-07.

GST 2.0 lowered SUV tax burden (large cars 40% flat vs 28%+cess up to 50%) and cut tractors to 5% (model knowledge); another cut is unlikely near term. +1 SSU (2-5pp) -> volume +3% -> EBITDA +5% x0.65 x0.5 = +1.6 -> +2.0 incl. tractors.

evidence.note: GST 2.0 rates not re-fetched this session
GST relief for farmers on retreaded tractor tyres from 1 Nov (Mint headline)

exposures.mechanism: M&M's born-electric SUV range and PLI eligibility make it a relative winner from stronger EV support: +1 SSU -> BEV mix +3-5pp, EV margins improve with PLI; est. EBITDA +4% x0.65 x0.5 structural = +1.3 -> +1.5.

US ~4% of consolidated auto/farm sales via Mahindra tractors (US assembly with Indian content) and exports; +10pp average tariff on Indian goods -> ~-1.5% EBITDA x0.65 x0.4 = -0.4. India-US trade talks stalled again (Reuters 2026-10-06); Rubio said deal 'very close' (2026-10-20); sector rallied on hopes post midterms (2026-11-05).

evidence.note: Auto sector rally on hopes of easing US tariffs after midterms
Why India-US trade talks stalled again

exposures.mechanism: +1 SSU = chip disruption lowering production ~4% for a quarter: 4% x gearing 1.6 = -6% quarterly EBITDA, -1.5% annualised x0.65 ... -2 incl. launch delays. No current disruption in sourced material.
SUV mix and XUV 7XO/Thar/Scorpio-N pricing power: premiumisation +1 -> mix +1.5pp, ASP +1% -> EBITDA +4% x0.65 x0.5 = +1.3 -> +1.5. SUV volumes at record 73,338 in Oct 2026 (ET Auto headline).

evidence.note: Record SUV sales of 73,338 units in Oct (headline; page blocked)

company_links.mechanism: Mahindra holds ~25.6% of Tech Mahindra (model knowledge, verify). 25.6% x TECHM mcap Rs 1.79 lakh cr = Rs 45.8k cr = 11.9% of M&M mcap (Rs 3.85 lakh cr); after ~30% holding-company discount -> 8.3% pass-through per +1% in TECHM (w = % M&M per +1% TECHM).

Mahindra holds ~52% of M&M Financial Services (model knowledge, verify); 52% x Rs 40,037 cr = Rs 20.8k cr = 5.4% of M&M mcap; ~30% discount -> 3.8% per +1% in M&MFIN. M&MFIN fell ~10% on 2026-10-22 despite +55% Q2 PAT (Business Today headline).

evidence.note: M&MFIN market cap Rs 40,037 cr; Q2 PAT Rs 882 cr (+55%)
